summary: Mitesco, Inc. filed an 8-K covering a routine bridge financing, unregistered sales of equity securities, director compensation in Series X Preferred stock, and the issuance of shares for dividends/redemptions. The bridge note is a $50,000 convertible promissory note (10% OID, 10% interest, 12-month maturity, $0.15/sh conversion). These are ordinary capital-raising and compensation arrangements, not a transformative special situation. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned, and no M&A or restructuring event is present. This filing is not a special situation.
